verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly left to right (bag → CITRINE/headline → CTA) and keeps the right hierarchy, but the bag is jammed against the top, bottom and left edges, the olive circle peeks out awkwardly behind the bag, and the CTA crowds the green circle. In B the two circles are stacked in a column on the left like stray dots, wasting the left third. CITRINE floats on its own far from the headline, the headline is pushed almost to the right edge, and the bag's label text is too small to read, so the layout looks scattered.
